comment: The Declared Target ratchet baseline for tools/scripts/check-nx-declared-targets.mjs (`yarn nx:targets:check`). Every entry is a target on an @nx/* executor that project.json still declares instead of leaving to Nx's Inferred Targets; the list can only shrink as later slices remove overrides (ADR 0082, PRD #762). A target present here with no matching project.json entry fails the check as stale — remove it in the same change that removes the override. A target found on the tree but absent here fails the check as a new Declared Target.
